purpose: One retrospective in-sample Clean capability probe of an unchanged published OPINE generated planner at one qualified native L6 root. This is not the historical online agent or a query-memory harm experiment.
resource_gate: Resource summary status is completed_native_reset_replay and qualification is exactly true.
Root metadata is qualified_actual_native_root with qualified_by_completed_panel true, index762, level5 and zero full-frame mismatch.
Register the unchanged game/adapter modules through the resource helper before reading its local pickle; restore saved Python/NumPy RNG.
Loaded and deep-copied actual environment frames and counters equal the saved root. No archive frame or learned history is injected into the environment.
initialization: Fresh load_model of round086 exactly once. No factual-prefix transition calls, memory overwrite, hypothetical pre-query, extra candidate enumeration, or completed-level verification. This isolates the released native planner component, not the complete engine gate/LLM/exploration/resynthesis loop.

planner.available_actions: Pass env.get_available_actions() unchanged; do not add L6 buttons, change keys, or invoke generic BFS.
planner.instrumentation: Only transparent call-count wrappers for transition_function/reward_function, shared by generated search and native validation; no extra model calls. Save initialized/final declared-global memory without modifying it.

real_execution.condition: Only result.ok=true and a returned plan of length1..40 permit execution.
real_execution.policy: Execute returned native plan verbatim once on the root deepcopy. Stop at plan exhaustion, level advancement, game win, game over, or native done; never replan or invoke a fallback actor.
real_execution.goal: Native L6 completion: actual environment level advancement or game win. Preserve native reward, done, game state and level at every step.
real_execution.no_plan: Record no_plan, timeout or model_error distinctly. Environment return and task success remain null, controls remain0; no unexecuted task is counted as a failure.

limits.enforcement: A separate parent process supervises one worker with timeout60seconds. It does not replace the worker's native SIGALRM planner deadline. Monotonic worker checks supplement the parent bound.

interpretation: One frozen published-program component on one existing development root. Round086 postdates step762; do not claim the author used it online there. A no-plan result is bounded planner infeasibility at this root, not a task failure rate, general incapability or immunity. If a returned plan fails, report that single real outcome without changing the planner. No query-memory damage is tested.
preexecution_review: Root and independent source review passed before planner import/call. Fresh native module component only; no factual-prefix warmup and no attack.
